verdict.rationale: Statsig documents randomized A/B and A/B/n experiments that split users into a control group and one or more test groups, then report metric lifts with confidence intervals on a scorecard of primary and secondary metrics. Power analysis and the Autotune multi-armed bandit, which shifts traffic toward and identifies a winning variant, round out the workflow, and community users praise the product's statistical rigor. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running an experiment directly on an existing feature gate (Layers only describe managing experiments and flags together), and hands-on corroboration of the winner-reporting UI.
